examples.en: Then the plague came into the house, and it carried off my husband. It seized my daughter too. I am a widow, and I sit at the hearth. No one speaks inside the house. Heavenly ones, why then did you take them and leave me?

examples.pie: kʷíd ḱód kʷéroy h₁én? tód mḗms séh₂lm̥-kʷe h₁ésmi dʰéh₁m̥. kénkoh₂. sddʰí h₁ddʰí-kʷe. solh₂wóm h₂ḱh₃dʰí.
examples.en: What is this in the pot? It is meat, and I put salt on it. I am hungry. Sit down and eat! Eat up everything!

examples.pie: wóyḱe moy wetsóm widés? h₁ím déh₂newi h₂éyeri widóm. h₂én h₁éyoh₂ h₁ím-kʷe h₂isḱṓh₂. ḱwónm̥ moy tébʰye ḱóm wédʰe. h₁éy solh₂wóm winédti.
examples.en: Neighbour, did you see my calf? I saw it at the river in the morning. I will go there and look for it. Bring my dog with you. He finds everything.

examples.pie: péḱu gʷowsth₂óy stestóh₂e. solh₂wóm péḱu dérḱs? oḱtṓw gʷṓs h₂én kʷéḱm̥. h₁néwn̥ téh₂es dʰǵʰyés h₁sént. kúdʰe albʰéh₂ h₁ésti? ne wóydh₂e.
examples.en: The cattle are standing in the stall. Did you look at all the cattle? I saw eight cows there. Yesterday there were nine. Where is the white one? I do not know.

examples.en: Now we have poured milk for you, shining one. Drink the warm milk, bright one. May the cows be many and healthy.

examples.en: Milk the cow at dawn. Heat the milk at the fire. Pour it warm into the fire. Give the remainder to the dog.

examples.pie: kʷíd méh₂ter pékʷesi? gʰostíbʰos nos dʰoHnéh₂m pékʷoh₂. péh₂urom moy dh₃dʰí. méne. dʰoHnéh₂ éti gʷʰerméh₂. h₂Hséh₂i ménōh₂.
examples.en: Mother, what are you baking? I am baking grain for our guests. Give me a little! Wait! The grain is still hot. I will wait at the hearth.
